subject: [hw] DONE DEC04: VDEC_ALL window + write-combining patches for V40; 1872/1872, ioctls 369->124
body:
DONE DEC04. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit (hw-v40 owns the patched files and applies the diffs).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST DEC04 PASS 1872/1872
Same run prints:
  DEC04 t_dec04 asan SUMMARY 144 144
  DEC04 t_dec04 o2   SUMMARY 144 144
  DEC04 t_dec04 tsan SUMMARY 144 144
  DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124 guest_stores=145 batches=45 max_batch=8
  N2TEST V40 PASS 1440/1440     (V40 suite on the patched /tmp copy, adapted t_v40.c)
Also: N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (patched n2vcu.c, arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only; manual, SDK path given explicitly because the mirror has no gpu/build). ~27 s, nice 10, one compile at a time, artifacts only in /tmp/n2hw-DEC04 (well under 100 MB).

Files (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/{dec04.patch, dec04-v40-adapt.patch, t_dec04.c, run_tests.sh, STATUS.md}; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC04/STATUS.md. I did NOT edit vcu/n2vcu.c, vcu/n2vcu.h or vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c in the tree.

What the patches change (details on the board post to hw-v40, sha256 a00cab9e... / 8580d5f7...):
- vcu_windows[] keeps the ten old VDEC entries first and appends the rev-3 RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL {0x16000000,0x30000}; only the gaps reach it (0x1000/0x2000/0x3800, larb5 0xd000, 0xe000, 0x11800, LAT 0x12000..0x18800, AVC_VLD 0x22000, PP 0x24000, 0x29000, larb4 0x2e000, 0x11400 tail). Guest MMIO and GCE share the table. mmio_bad and gce_skipped are 0 on the DEC02 stand-in replay.
- write-combining: aligned 32-bit guest stores queue into one rwvc_reg_op batch, flushed before guest read, sub-word/unaligned store, GCE entry/list, poll, wait_irq, power change, any ioctl entry, close/destroy, and at 256 ops; order preserved; default OFF per V40 (n2vcu_set_write_combining(v,1) enables). Stats hw_regs_calls + wc_* appended.
- The V40 test adaptation is required, not cosmetic: rev 3 makes 0x16001000 a real VDEC page, so its one "bad address" expectation cannot stay. Without the adaptation V40 fails exactly those two checks; verified.

Oracle replay, as required: same ordered write record (window/offset/value/mask), same final image of every window, same guest read values, with and without combining; only the batch count changes (369 -> 124 back-end calls on the stand-in trace).

Not done / unresolved (full list in dsh-state/workers/DEC04/STATUS.md):
- No phone run. No DEC02 PAGES.md yet: the oracle uses the facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section 4 page list; I re-run when it lands.
- include/redwood_vcodec.h is still rev 2 (no RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL). The patches use the real name; run_tests.sh stages the proposed enum line in the /tmp mirror only, tree header untouched. Waiting on hw-lead for the exact rev-3 text and the larb read-only decision (asked).
- No V40-side larb write refusal (model maps addresses only); kernel/DEC07/T02 own that policy.
- Combining defaults OFF, so DEC01/DEC05 must enable it once per model; a failed batch loses its stores and is counted only in wc_errors.
- Patch base is V40 rev 5; rebase on request if rev 6 moves the hunks.

Staying available for R1/R2/lead findings.
